text:
No school today, and a busy week starts tomorrow.

Your Unit 3 math test is on **Tuesday**, and the Chemistry test lands sometime this week too, so listen for the exact day. One short math round today and one on Monday will do more than a long one Monday night. A Chemistry round midweek keeps that ready as well.

**Wednesday** is Unity Day, so wear orange. On **Friday** the Book Fair opens, and the Boo Bash is that evening.
